native_record: capture_schema/request/query_cursor/response_utf8/response_sha256/response_truncated plus parsed response. Retain original UTF8 serialization, hash it before parse and require exact parsed object correspondence.
native_response_shape: schemaVersion/thread/page/turns; known thread and turn metadata retained; observed agentMessage phases commentary/final_answer; nontext functionCallOutput/commandExecution/reasoning retained, never ACK sources.
synthetic_schema_version: fixture value1 is not a claim of authenticated actual SDK version; actual connector/version compatibility remains separate HOLD
cursor_domains: claim.pre_send_cursor and snapshot.cursor are wait-event cursor. First raw read request has NO cursor key, query_cursor and legacy first request_cursor null; subsequent request.cursor/query_cursor follow exact opaque page.nextCursor bytes, not wait cursor. Do not parse opaque cursor internals.
phase_mapping: version1 maps only raw commentary->commentary, final_answer->final for normalized identity; raw phase always retained. Non-agent normalized text is empty by explicit nonmatching convention, never extracted from tools.
boundedness: before-send terminal predecessor + initial fresh-top + continuous newest-first walk reaching predecessor + final fresh-top same top. Keep final hasMore true/older continuation; never claim full history exhausted.
matched_result: existing action/reason/turn_id/claim_id plus window.projection_version,wait_event_cursor,scope=post-send-through-predecessor,predecessor_turn,full_history_exhausted=false,native_continuation and exact audit_index
HOLD_cases: cursor-domain mixing or explicit cursor on fresh top
wrong raw digest or raw/parsed/legacy correspondence
actual_native_auth_transport_permissions: HOLD separately; no private raw capture in fixtures
